prompt: A freshly installed Redis with default configuration answers only on the loopback interface. Which mechanism causes this?
explanation: Protected mode makes an unconfigured server (no bind directive and no password/ACL set) accept connections only from 127.0.0.1 ::1, so a default install is not exposed to the network until an operator explicitly binds interfaces or sets up authentication.

options.text: Protected mode, which limits an unconfigured server to loopback connections
The default ACL denies all remote users until ACL SETUSER grants access
TLS is required for any non-loopback connection by default
Redis only opens a network socket once a password is configured
